log.raw: {"understanding":{"purpose":"Provide a multilingual reference for checkout interface strings, keyed by stable identifiers.","tasks":["Find a string by its key.","Compare translations across languages for the same key.","Read or copy an individual interface string."],"relations":["Each row joins one identifier to its English, Chinese, Japanese and Arabic versions.","Language columns have parallel roles; the key identifies the row."],"roles":["The first row labels the identifier and language columns.","The first column contains row headers; the remaining columns contain translations."],"keep_whole":["Identifiers and their dot-separated segments where space permits.","Words, numbers and short phrases where possible."],"may_wrap":["Translations at natural word or script-appropriate boundaries.","Long identifiers when the viewport-constrained design cannot accommodate them whole."],"same_scale":["Language columns have comparable importance, but their widths can differ to accommodate script and text length.","All keys share one column and should align consistently."],"h_vs_v":"A viewport-fitting table keeps all languages visible together but forces severe wrapping, especially in keys. Scrolling preserves identifiers and gives translations more natural lines, at the cost of moving horizontally to compare distant languages."},"designs":[{"widths":[90,67,60,72,70],"strategy":"Fit all five columns within 359px to keep every language visible, accepting fragmented identifiers and tall rows."},{"widths":[227,150,110,150,130],"strategy":"Use a moderately wide scrolling table that preserves every key and gives each language room for natural wrapping."},{"widths":[227,217,205,304,208],"strategy":"Use a wide scrolling reference table sized for one-line content, making individual rows compact and easy to scan once reached."}]}
